navbarWidth.description: Pre-existing Node and copied Laravel markup both expanded the fixed navbar beyond the mobile viewport during AOS transitions. The Laravel stylesheet now caps the navbar and mobile menu at 100vw.

findings.bladeMetadata: Existing JSON-LD is enclosed in @verbatim so Blade does not interpret @context as a directive.

limitations: Physical devices and real mobile keyboards were not tested; responsive, touch and keyboard behavior was emulated in headless Chrome.
The original Node website retains its existing fixed-navbar mobile width quirk and missing /favicon.ico. Original files were deliberately not edited.
Contact and newsletter forms retain their existing browser-only behavior; no submission storage or delivery was added.
Production deployment and any AI API migration require separate Phase 4.3 approval.
